evidence.quote:
But his features
stiffened ever so slightly and into his eyes came an expression such as
comes into the eyes of the hunter when, after stealthily stalking, he
comes into view of his quarry.
evidence.paraphrase: Miller reacts intensely, like a hunter sighting prey, upon seeing someone in the lobby.

evidence.quote:
I want him followed tonight and to-morrow. Get McCampbell to help
you and split up the work so he won fffd fffdt see too much of either one of
you. I want to know what he does, who he sees, what he talks about.
evidence.paraphrase: Carmichael organizes systematic surveillance to gather information about Miller.

evidence.quote:
Suddenly the grim stoicism with which he had been speaking departed.
His face distorted and his voice broke, as he implored
evidence.paraphrase: Alsbury's composure breaks as he emotionally pleads for his daughter's sake.
